title: Retiree March Ends in Violence
text:
Tensions erupted in Buenos Aires as a recent retiree protest led to clashes and the deployment of pepper gas, sparking outrage and raising serious questions about public safety. This article delves into the details of the incident, examining the escalating confrontations between protesters and law enforcement and the impact on those involved. Learn more about the ongoing issues surrounding the Buenos Aires retiree protests and what led to the volatile situation.
Tensions Flare at Retiree Protest in Buenos Aires: Pepper Gas Deployed Buenos Aires, Argentina – Protests in support of retirees took a volatile turn Wednesday as law enforcement deployed pepper gas against demonstrators near Congress. The weekly demonstrations, intended to advocate for pensioners’ rights, have increasingly become flashpoints for clashes between protesters and authorities.
The latest incident involved Federal Police, Gendarmerie, and Airport Security Police attempting to manage the crowd. Initial attempts to contain the protesters led to physical altercations.
Initial Confrontation: Protesters attempting to block traffic near Congress triggered a response from law enforcement. Pepper Gas Deployment: As tensions escalated, security forces used pepper gas to disperse the crowd. Medical Assistance: The Emergency Medical Care System (SAME) provided assistance to numerous affected protesters, including elderly individuals. Escalation and containment Authorities initially erected fences near Congress in anticipation of the protest. However, demonstrators managed to advance, leading to direct confrontations with law enforcement.the Airport Security Police established a cordon,attempting to move protesters off the street and onto the sidewalks at the intersection of Avenues Entre Ríos and Rivadavia.
Despite these efforts, some protesters remained on Rivadavia Avenue, prompting police to form a double cordon to contain the demonstration. The situation remained tense as authorities sought to prevent further disruptions.
Video footage of the clashes between police and protesters near Congress. Aftermath and Response Following the clashes, one protester was arrested by the Federal Police for allegedly assaulting an officer, according to police sources. The Gendarmerie also played a significant role, pressing in from the opposite side of the street and deploying pepper gas again as they moved protesters toward the square of the two congresses.
Medical personnel attended to numerous individuals affected by the gas. Television footage showed peopel receiving treatment from SAME and volunteer medics.
Today we calculated more than 70 assisted, there were many foci and teams working. We tried to concentrate and serve everyone.
A rescuer who assisted protesters, speaking on C5n
The rescuer further noted that two individuals were transported by ambulance, including a 13-year-old girl who experienced a panic attack after being caught in the middle of the clashes.
Mega-Operation and Continued Tensions The combined security forces deployed a large-scale operation, effectively surrounding the corners of rivadavia Avenue. Eventually, traffic was reopened as troops mobilized to prevent protesters from re-blocking the street.
The recurring tensions at these weekly retiree protests have led to increased security measures. In a previous demonstration, authorities deployed 1,500 federal and city troops to maintain order and contain the protests, along with 600 traffic agents to manage vehicular flow.
Background: Escalating Clashes the intensity of these protests has been building.A demonstration on March 12 saw the involvement of “barrabravas,” soccer fans,and left-wing groups,resulting in numerous injuries and arrests. that protest brought controversial cases to light.
Among those injured in previous protests were Pablo Grillo, a photographer struck by a tear gas canister, and Beatriz Blanco, an elderly woman who fell after being pushed by a police officer.
While the level of violence has fluctuated, tensions remain high at these recurring demonstrations.
